verdict.rationale: Galileo captures real-time production traces/spans (galileo-docs-6, galileo-docs-7), supports alerting on live metrics like cost and hallucination (galileo-docs-9, galileo-docs-14), monitors adherence/hallucination metrics continuously (galileo-docs-18), and explicitly offers Luna models distilled from evals to monitor 100% of production traffic at low cost (galileo-docs-12), plus building datasets from live production data (galileo-docs-11). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of continuous production monitoring at scale, and no explicit SLA/latency detail on real-time evaluator execution.
